description: All UI components and all Next.js pages. Covers layout components, session components, workspace tabs, UI primitives, and all 20 pages (homepage, app workspace, SEO landing pages, legal pages). Depends on FEAT-001 (globals.css, types), FEAT-002 (API routes), FEAT-003 (hooks). This is the largest feature — all steps should be done in order since later components compose earlier ones.
steps: Create src/components/ui/Button.tsx — polymorphic button with variants: 'primary' (indigo), 'danger' (red), 'ghost' (transparent), 'secondary' (slate). Sizes: 'sm', 'md', 'lg'. Props: variant, size, loading (shows spinner), disabled, onClick, children, className, type. Uses Tailwind. Fully accessible with focus-visible ring. Export as default.

Create src/components/ui/Badge.tsx — status badge component. Variants: 'success' (green), 'warning' (yellow), 'danger' (red), 'info' (blue), 'neutral' (slate). Props: variant, children, className. Small pill shape. Export as default.

Create src/components/ui/Modal.tsx — 'use client'. Accessible modal dialog using a backdrop div + centered panel. Props: isOpen, onClose, title, children, size ('sm'|'md'|'lg'). Traps focus on open, closes on Escape key or backdrop click. Uses createPortal to render at body level. Includes close X button. Export as default.

Create src/components/ui/Toast.tsx — 'use client'. Toast notification system. ToastProvider context wraps app. useToast() hook returns { showToast(msg: string, type: 'success'|'error'|'info'|'warning') }. Toasts auto-dismiss after 4 seconds. Render at top-right corner. Stack up to 5 toasts. Export ToastProvider, useToast.

Create src/components/layout/Header.tsx — 'use client'. Site header: logo (text 'OnlineCopyPaste' + lightning bolt emoji), navigation links (hidden on mobile, hamburger menu), connection status indicator (calls useConnectionStatus), CTA button 'Start Session'. Sticky, backdrop blur. Shows session timer if session is active (prop: sessionExpiresAt?). Export as default.

Create src/components/layout/Footer.tsx — Site footer (server component). Links: Privacy, Terms, Cookies, About, Contact, Security, How It Works, FAQ. Copyright notice. Short tagline. Export as default.

Create src/components/layout/ConnectionStatus.tsx — 'use client'. Small indicator badge showing ONLINE (green), LOCAL (yellow), or OFFLINE (red) mode. Uses useConnectionStatus hook. Tooltip on hover explaining what each mode means. Export as default.

Create src/components/session/SessionCreator.tsx — 'use client'. The main session creation UI shown on homepage/lab-mode. Shows: (1) duration selector (10 min / 30 min / 1 hour radio buttons), (2) 'Start Session' button that calls useSession.createSession(), (3) loading state, (4) on success shows QR code image, 6-digit pair code ('XXX XXX' formatted), join URL, 'Copy Link' button, instructions ('Scan QR on your phone or go to onlinecopypaste.net/join/XXXXXX'). Handles error state. After pairing shows 'Go to Workspace' button. Props: onSessionCreated(sessionId: string, token: string): void. Export as default.

Create src/components/session/SessionJoiner.tsx — 'use client'. Phone-side join UI. Shows 6-digit code input (2 groups of 3, auto-focus, numeric keyboard on mobile). 'Join Session' button calls useSession.joinSession(code). On success redirects to /app?sessionId=...&role=phone. Also shows QR scanner note ('Just scan the QR code on the PC screen'). Handles invalid code error. Export as default.

Create src/components/session/SessionTimer.tsx — 'use client'. Countdown timer showing time remaining before session expires. Props: expiresAt: Date. Displays as 'MM:SS' or 'HH:MM:SS'. Turns red when < 5 minutes remain. Shows 'Session expired' when done and triggers onExpired callback. Export as default.

Create src/components/session/DestroySession.tsx — 'use client'. Prominent destroy session button with skull/fire emoji. On click: shows confirmation Modal ('Are you sure? This will disconnect all devices and delete all transfer data.'). On confirm: calls useSession.destroySession(), clears sessionStorage, shows success toast, redirects to /. Button styled as danger variant, large, with warning text beneath ('Your session is temporary. Destroy when done.'). Export as default.

Create src/components/workspace/Workspace.tsx — 'use client'. The main workspace shell rendered at /app. Uses useWebRTC({ sessionId, token, role }) and useTransferQueue(). Shows: (1) top bar with session code, SessionTimer, ConnectionStatus, DestroySession button. (2) Tab bar: Clipboard | Code | Files | Links | Images | Notes | Transfers. (3) Tab content panel. (4) Paired status / connecting state overlay. Reads sessionId, token, role from URL search params (useSearchParams). If no session in sessionStorage, redirects to /. Export as default.

Create src/components/workspace/ClipboardTab.tsx — 'use client'. Props: send(data: string): void, received: string[]. Large textarea for typing/pasting text. 'Send' button sends via DataChannel. Received items listed below, each with a 'Copy' button that calls navigator.clipboard.writeText(). Character count. Export as default.

Create src/components/workspace/CodeTab.tsx — 'use client'. Props: send(data: string): void, received: string[]. Code editor textarea (monospace font, line numbers via CSS counter). Language auto-detection using detectContentType/detectLanguage. Syntax highlighted preview using Prism.js. 'Send Code' button. Received snippets shown with copy button. Export as default.

Create src/components/workspace/FilesTab.tsx — 'use client'. Props: send(files: File[]): void, transfers: TransferState[]. Embeds DropZone component. Lists active/queued transfers using TransferProgress component. Shows received files with download link and FilePreview. Export as default.

Create src/components/workspace/LinksTab.tsx — 'use client'. Props: send(url: string): void, received: string[]. URL input with validation. Send button. Received URLs shown as clickable links with favicon and Open/Copy buttons. Export as default.

Create src/components/workspace/ImagesTab.tsx — 'use client'. Props: send(files: File[]): void, received: Array<{url: string, name: string}>. Image-specific drop zone (accept='image/*'). Grid of received image thumbnails. Click to enlarge in Modal. Download button. Export as default.

Create src/components/workspace/NotesTab.tsx — 'use client'. Props: send(note: string): void, received: string[]. Rich-ish note input (auto-growing textarea). 'Send Note' button. Received notes shown as cards with timestamp and copy button. Export as default.

Create src/components/workspace/TransfersTab.tsx — 'use client'. Props: transfers: TransferState[], onCancel(id: string): void. Complete transfer history: pending, active, completed, failed. Each item uses TransferProgress component. 'Clear Completed' button. Export as default.

Create src/components/ads/AdSlot.tsx — 'use client'. Renders Google AdSense ad unit. Props: slot: string, format?: string, style?: React.CSSProperties. If NEXT_PUBLIC_ADSENSE_ID is not set, returns null. In dev with NEXT_PUBLIC_SHOW_AD_PLACEHOLDERS=true, renders a gray placeholder div with 'Ad Placeholder' text. Uses useEffect to call (window.adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({}) after mount. Export as default.

Create src/app/page.tsx — Homepage (server component shell + client SessionCreator). Above-the-fold: hero section with headline 'Transfer anything between your phone and PC — no account needed', subheadline, 'Start Free Session' CTA. How it works: 3-step visual (Open → Scan → Transfer). Features grid: No Account, End-to-End Encrypted, Auto-Expiry, Works Everywhere, PWA, Open Source. Use cases section targeting: students, labs, developers. AdSlot below hero. SessionCreator component (lazy-loaded via dynamic import with ssr:false). SEO metadata export.

Create src/app/app/page.tsx — 'use client' workspace page. Renders Workspace component. Reads searchParams for sessionId/token/role. If missing, redirects to /. This is the paired workspace — only reachable after session creation/joining. No static metadata (dynamic page).

Create src/app/join/[code]/page.tsx — 'use client'. Join page for phone. Reads [code] param from URL (from QR scan). Pre-fills the SessionJoiner with the code. Shows 'Joining session XXXXXX...' heading. If no code, shows the SessionJoiner with empty input for manual entry. SEO metadata: noindex (dynamic session page).

Create src/app/lab-mode/page.tsx — Lab Mode landing page (server + dynamic SessionCreator). Emphasizes: No login required, Temporary session, QR pairing, Auto-expiry, Destroy when done. 'Lab Mode' banner/badge. Checklist of lab-safe features. SessionCreator component. Privacy promise section. AdSlot. SEO metadata.

Create src/app/phone-to-pc/page.tsx — SEO landing page. Target keyword: 'send files from phone to PC without USB'. Content: hero, step-by-step guide with screenshots/diagrams, comparison vs alternatives (WhatsApp/email/USB), FAQ section, CTA. Static server component for SEO. AdSlot.
Create src/app/online-clipboard/page.tsx — SEO landing page. Target keyword: 'online clipboard between devices'. Content: what it is, how it works, use cases, CTA. Static server component.

Create src/app/file-transfer/page.tsx — SEO landing page. Target keyword: 'transfer files between phone and computer'. Content: hero, features list (supports images/PDF/ZIP/docs), max file size info, privacy notes, CTA. Static.

Create src/app/code-transfer/page.tsx — SEO landing page. Target keyword: 'share code between devices'. Content: hero for developers/students, syntax highlighting mention, code snippet examples, CTA. Static.

Create src/app/how-it-works/page.tsx — Detailed how-it-works page. Three connection modes explained (Online/Local/Offline). Architecture diagram (ASCII or CSS). WebRTC explanation (what is P2P, what the signaling server does and does NOT store). Step-by-step flow with illustrations. FAQ at bottom. Static.

Create src/app/security/page.tsx — Security & Privacy page. Explain: WebRTC encryption (DTLS/SRTP), what the signaling server sees (only session metadata, not content), session auto-expiry, destroy session guarantee, no account requirement, no persistent storage of files. Be accurate — do not overclaim. Static.

Create src/app/faq/page.tsx — FAQ page. 15+ questions covering: how does it work, is it secure, what file types, max file size, does it work without internet, what happens when session expires, can I use it on mobile only, do files go through your server. Static. Schema.org FAQ markup via JSON-LD in metadata.

Create src/app/privacy/page.tsx — Privacy Policy. Cover: what data is collected (none persistently), session metadata (IP, temporary), cookies (none beyond functional), third-party services (AdSense, GA4 if configured), data retention (session expiry = data deleted), contact info. Static.
Create src/app/terms/page.tsx — Terms of Service. Cover: service description, acceptable use (no illegal content, no abuse), service availability, limitation of liability, changes to terms. Static.
Create src/app/cookies/page.tsx — Cookie Policy. Cover: types of cookies (functional only, no tracking unless GA4/AdSense configured), how to control cookies. Static.
Create src/app/about/page.tsx — About page. Product story (built for students using lab computers), mission, team/solo developer note, open source mention. Static.

Create src/app/contact/page.tsx — Contact page. Static page with email address placeholder (support@onlinecopypaste.net), GitHub issues link, note about no account needed to use the service. No contact form (avoids spam/server complexity). Static.

Create tests/e2e/e2e-test-plan.md — Manual E2E test plan covering: (1) Session creation flow, (2) QR code scanning pairing, (3) Manual code entry pairing, (4) Text/clipboard transfer phone→PC, (5) Text transfer PC→phone, (6) File upload and transfer, (7) Image preview, (8) Code snippet transfer with syntax highlighting, (9) Destroy session, (10) Session expiry, (11) Offline mode detection, (12) PWA install prompt, (13) Mobile responsiveness, (14) Ad slot rendering (with and without ADSENSE_ID). Each test has: precondition, steps, expected result.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes with zero errors — all pages and components compile
Homepage (/) renders with hero section and SessionCreator via dynamic import
All workspace tab components (Clipboard, Code, Files, Links, Images, Notes, Transfers) are implemented
DestroySession button shows confirmation modal before destroying
AdSlot renders null when NEXT_PUBLIC_ADSENSE_ID is not set
All legal pages (privacy, terms, cookies) exist and render
SessionTimer counts down and turns red under 5 minutes
DropZone rejects files over size limit with error message
All SEO pages have proper metadata exports
verification: npm run build — Next.js build succeeds, no missing modules, no type errors during build
findings: All 37 files created successfully. npm run type-check passes with zero errors. npm run build succeeds generating 22 routes (16 static pages + 4 API routes + /join/[code] dynamic + /_not-found). npm test passes 88 tests (all pre-existing from FEAT-001/002/003). Key notes: (1) UI primitives — Button (4 variants, 3 sizes, loading spinner), Badge (5 variants), Modal (createPortal + focus trap + Escape/backdrop close), Toast (ToastProvider context + useToast hook, auto-dismiss 4s, max 5). (2) Layout — Header is 'use client' for hamburger menu and SessionTimer; Footer is server component. ConnectionStatus uses useConnectionStatus hook with tooltip per mode. (3) Session — SessionCreator uses dynamic import with ssr:false on homepage and lab-mode pages (avoids sessionStorage SSR). DestroySession shows Modal confirmation before calling destroySession(). SessionTimer turns red < 5min, fires onExpired callback. SessionJoiner pre-fills code from URL params, numeric input keyboard on mobile. (4) Workspace — Workspace.tsx reads sessionId/token/role from useSearchParams() inside Suspense boundary at /app/page.tsx. Tab architecture: 7 tabs (Clipboard/Code/Files/Links/Images/Notes/Transfers). Connected/disconnected overlay shown while waiting for peer. (5) AdSlot — returns null if NEXT_PUBLIC_ADSENSE_ID not set; renders gray placeholder if NEXT_PUBLIC_SHOW_AD_PLACEHOLDERS=true; calls window.adsbygoogle.push in useEffect after mount. (6) SEO pages — all static server components with proper metadata exports. /faq has JSON-LD FAQPage schema. /join/[code] is 'use client' dynamic page with noindex intent. (7) All workspace tabs wrapped in ToastProvider locally — not injected at root layout level (root layout remains a server component). (8) All 14 E2E test cases documented in tests/e2e/e2e-test-plan.md.
